args.title: Remember the export format last used in ExportButton
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Change the ExportButton component to remember the last selected export format in localStorage or similar browser storage so it can restore the last used format when the user reopens the report, instead of defaulting every time to CSV.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The ExportButton component currently defaults the export format to CSV every time. This change will make it remember the last export format selected by the user in the browser (localStorage), so the menu defaults to the last used format, preventing accidental CSV exports when XLSX was previously chosen. This meets the reporter's request to remember the export format in the browser.
